title: Finite convergence of the Moment-SOS hierarchy under hidden convexity
summary: We consider polynomial optimization problems with compact feasible set ${\bfΩ}\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ defined by SOS-concave polynomials $g_j$ of arbitrary degree, and whose objective function $f$ is not necessarily convex on $\mathbb{R}^d$. We show that, if $f$ is Hessian-$Q$-module convex over ${\bfΩ}$ in the sense that its Hessian admits a specific quadratic-module representation, then the standard Moment-SOS hierarchy converges in finitely many steps without prior knowledge of this hidden (local) convexity.
